en: Final production in limited quantities to commemorate Gunpla's 30th anniversary!
Gundam with a total height of 1.5 meters! HY2M 1/12 Gundam outfit is now available in a new animation color version!
A seal with a serial number that can be attached to the aircraft is also included! !
Assembly type display model (*partially assembled)
Target age: 15 years old or older
Product material (main body): PS, POM, PP, urethane resin, ASA, PE, stainless steel
Total height: approx. 1.5 meters
Weight: Approximately 35kg
*Sound/light unit is not included with this product.
*Delivery packaging format: 3 pieces (approximately 38 kg)
(Set contents)
・ 1/12 Gundam body ・ Beam saber
・Beam rifle ・Premium MarkingSeal
・ GundamSeal ・ Assembly tool (hex wrench set)
[Free shipping] [Free cash on delivery fee] [Payment by credit card accepted]
‘Hobby Online Shop’ limited edition items
"Gunpla 30th Anniversary Limited Quantity Final Production"
This is the final production of the ‘HY2M 1/12RX-78-2Gundam’.
Also, as quantities are limited, we recommend making your reservation early!
(Product specifications)
- Gundam body is in animation color.
・ Premium MarkingSeal included
"Premium Marking Seal" total 4 pieces
・New markings full of reality, including caution marks designed to Gunpla specifications
・It also includes the ``GUNPLA 30th'' logo mark and serial number, which are essential as commemorative items.
The serial number can also be pasted on the aircraft! !
Equivalent to A4 size (for aircraft marking) Tetron Seal x 3 sheets
A5 size equivalent (for dressing up the inside of the joint) Foil Seal x 1 piece
- The upper body and head are movable, such as posing with weapons, etc.
It is possible to display it in the powerful poses that only a life-size model can provide.
(Posing can be stabilized and fixed with screws.)
(remarks)
・This product is available for pre-order and is produced in limited quantities.
Applications will be closed as soon as the available quantity is reached. Thank you for your understanding.
・This product is a limited item sold at the 'Hobby Online Shop'.
*We may sell items at events sponsored by our company or other projects.
*Cannot be purchased at stores that carry plastic models.
・Product images are under development and may differ from the actual product.
- Product specifications are scheduled as of 2010514. Please note that there may be changes.
